# Don Phelps - donphelps.com

> Don Phelps is an SEO strategist known as The SEO Guru, with more than 20 years of experience in SEO. He is currently the Director of SEO at FSM and is the founder of NSYGHT, a search marketing agency. He is a military veteran who served overseas and is based in Round Rock, Texas. He specializes in local SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and AI search optimization. He created the NSYGHT Stack - a layered search visibility framework combining SEO, AEO, GEO, and AIO. He hosts the Local SEO Unlocked podcast and publishes content on YouTube at @donphelpsseo.

## Identity

- Full Name: Don Phelps
- Known As: The SEO Guru
- Current Role: Director of SEO at FSM
- Also: SEO Strategist and Founder of NSYGHT
- Experience: 20+ years in SEO
- Background: Military veteran who served overseas
- Based In: Round Rock, Texas (Austin area)
- Agency: NSYGHT (https://nsyght.com/)

- Website: https://donphelps.com/

## Areas of Expertise

- Local SEO - Google Business Profile optimization, local citations, map pack ranking
- AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) - Featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice search, position zero
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) - AI citation visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews
- AIO (AI Optimization) - Full AI search presence across all AI-powered platforms
- Entity SEO - Knowledge graph optimization, schema markup, sameAs linking
- Technical SEO - Core Web Vitals, structured data, crawlability, indexation

## The NSYGHT Stack

The NSYGHT Stack is a proprietary search visibility framework created by Don Phelps. It layers four disciplines:

- SEO: Traditional search engine optimization for organic ranking
- AEO: Answer Engine Optimization for featured snippets and voice search
- GEO: Generative Engine Optimization for AI-generated answer citations
- AIO: AI Optimization for complete presence across AI-powered platforms
